train_one_epoch: run the train_one_epoch function to train a PyTorch model for one epoch with mixed precision and optional mixup augmentation
evaluate_model: evaluate the evaluate function to compute accuracy and loss on a validation dataset using cross entropy loss
train_with_ema: train a model with model_ema for exponential moving average updates during each training epoch
train_with_mixup: train a model using mixup_fn to apply mixup data augmentation on samples and targets each batch
run_training_loop: run the training loop with loss_scaler, gradient clipping, and metric logging across all processes
